creatures.name: The Rag
creatures.description: Coarse stained cloth suspended in mid-air at human height with nobody standing beneath it. It exudes a toxic emission that causes blurred vision and a sinking feeling underfoot.

actions.name: Toxic Emanation
actions.telegraph: The air thickens into a sickly miasma as the suspended cloth drifts forward.

creatures.name: The Sprinter
creatures.description: A dark humanoid silhouette that sprints from behind doorways at breakneck speed, colliding violently before vanishing into unlit corners.

actions.name: Sudden Lunge
actions.telegraph: A blurred shadow bursts around the doorframe.

creatures.name: The Ember Cloud
creatures.description: A dense cloud of swirling dust and fire embers hovering in the hallway, accompanied by an eerie tune that refuses to lose tempo.

actions.name: Eerie Resonance
actions.telegraph: A shrill metallic chime builds to an unbearable pitch.

creatures.name: The Drip
creatures.description: Coagulated organic matter hanging from plaster ceiling cracks, pulsing and dripping dark fluids in synchronized, unnatural rhythm.

actions.name: Visceral Cascade
actions.telegraph: Ceiling plaster buckles as heavy crimson fluid gathers overhead.

creatures.name: The Final Verdict
creatures.description: An amalgamation of all Vermin Black's atrocities made manifest: razor blades, cold bathtubs, whined complaints, weeping infants, and stitched intestines assembled into a towering, relentless judgment.

actions.name: Weight of What Was Done
actions.telegraph: Voices of forgotten victims rise in a deafening, unified accusation.
